titulo: Jetstar to charge fees to put carry-on luggage in overhead lockers
cuerpo: Airline to remove 7kg weight limit for carry-on bags and introduce new fee from February 2027 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Jetstar will charge its passengers to put carry-on luggage in the overhead lockers, in a major change to the budget airline’s carry-on rules. The airline on Wednesday announced it would remove the 7kg weight limit for carry-on bags, beginning in February 2027. There will still be size restrictions. Continue reading...
